title: Reconcile 9pd A2 with the checkpoint-conflict decision taken in wdb
body: A2 says a run-state conflict does not end the run and fails only after a bounded number of consecutive conflicts. reconcile.go:1341-1352 ends the run on the first checkpoint conflict, by the decision recorded in wdb's close note, and A2 was never amended the way A3 and A4 were. Either amend A2 or implement the bounded continue, before 9t5 certifies it.
